query: INSERT INTO core.parser_runs( source_document_id,parser_name,parser_version,status,output_record_count,output_digest, started_at,completed_at,input_content_sha256,extraction_schema_version, implementation_sha256,extraction_receipt_sha256) SELECT d.id,'connector-structured-json','connector-structured-json-v1','SUCCEEDED',$2,$3, clock_timestamp(),clock_timestamp(),d.content_sha256,'v1',p.implementation_digest,$4 FROM raw.source_documents d JOIN core.parser_versions p ON p.parser_name='connector-structured-json' AND p.version='connector-structured-json-v1' AND p.status='ACTIVE' WHERE d.id=$1 RETURNING id
